benchmarks.name: SPY × FAMILY (Berlint Cold War)
benchmarks.capabilityTested: Multi-Agent Concealment, Private Agendas & Social Camouflage
benchmarks.hypothesis: Can HeadConan create a convincing social world where multiple characters maintain secret identities, conflicting hidden goals, and domestic camouflage without breaking epistemic isolation?

benchmarks.name: Game of Thrones (Westeros War of the Five Kings)
benchmarks.capabilityTested: Multi-Faction Statecraft, Asymmetric Power & Cascading Policy Consequences
benchmarks.hypothesis: Can HeadConan maintain a persistent political simulation where macro decrees alter multi-faction power balances, economic resources, and military stances, producing emergent diplomatic crises rather than scripted narrative dead-ends?

benchmarks.name: Outer Wilds (22-Minute Solar Loop)
benchmarks.capabilityTested: Spatial Wonder, Ontological Physics Rules & Epistemic Progression
benchmarks.hypothesis: Can HeadConan simulate a geographically and physically coherent world where environmental rules remain constant, exploration is driven by user curiosity, and discovered lore directly unlocks solutions to physical environmental puzzles?

benchmarks.name: Victorian Sherlock London (Baker Street 1895)
benchmarks.capabilityTested: Forensic Deduction, Incomplete Information & Immutable Ground Truth
benchmarks.hypothesis: Can HeadConan maintain a sealed ground truth for complex mysteries, allowing users to discover clues incrementally, connect evidence nodes on an interactive pinboard, and deduce perpetrators through valid inference rather than forced scripted reveals?
